result.summary: No critical blockers are visible. The page is largely usable, but there are a few minor visual/content concerns around edge clipping, ambiguous promotional labeling, and low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: Category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the right edge of the viewport, which can look like broken truncation rather than intentional horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle edge fade/gradient or peek spacing to make horizontal scrolling clearly intentional.

issues.description: The bottom visible promo badge shows “-100%”, which is ambiguous and may read as an error rather than a discount/free offer.
issues.suggestion: Replace with clearer copy such as “100% off”, “Free”, or the exact promotion terms.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees, time ranges, and cuisine labels use small gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size slightly and/or darken the gray to meet stronger contrast guidance.
